# dsh-zh-ui
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin for Chinese-language UI work. It has three parts:
1. **Skill `zh-ui-design`**: Chinese typography rules (spacing between Chinese and Latin/digits, ful
l-width punctuation, CJK font stacks with fallbacks, line-height 1.6–1.8, 25–40 characters per line)
, an anti-"generated look" checklist, and a "design direction first" workflow and 4 style presets (o
bservatory, night-shift, cobalt-poster, trust), each with complete CSS custom properties and nav / h
ero / pricing-card / CTA recipes. Preset text/background pairs are checked against WCAG AA (4.5:1).
2. **Project spec injection**: on every prompt assembly, reads `DESIGN.md` and `design.tokens.json`
from the session's working directory and appends them as runtime context (not the cached system prom

pt). Nothing is injected when the files are absent.
3. **Tool `zh_design_lint`**: static scan of HTM
L / CSS / SCSS / Vue / JSX / TSX / Svelte sources and Tailwind classes. It does not render pages.
## zh_design_lint rules
| Rule | What it reports |
| `hardcoded-color` | Literal colors outside custom-property definitions (`--x:`), and Tailwind arbi

trary colors `bg-[#…]`. Colors listed in `design.tokens.json` are allowed. |
| `off-scale-px` | px v
alues in margin / padding / gap / font-size / border-radius / inset properties that are not multiple
s of the spacing base (default 4px); Tailwind `p-[13px]` etc. 0, 1, 2 and token px values are allowe

d. |
| `font-family-cjk` | `font-family` stacks with no Chinese font (PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei,

Noto Sans SC, …). `var(...)`, `inherit` and monospace stacks are skipped. |
| `cjk-latin-spacing` |

Visible text where a Chinese character directly touches a Latin letter or digit. |
| `cjk-punctuatio

n` | Half-width `, ; : ! ? .` next to Chinese characters. |
| `cjk-line-height` | Unitless `line-hei
ght` below 1.5 on body-text selectors (headings, buttons, prices etc. excluded); `leading-none/tight

/snug` on `

`, `

  • ` and similar. | | `purple-gradient` | Gradients containing a violet/purple co

lor (hue 250°–320°); Tailwind `from/via/to-purple|violet|fuchsia-*`. |
| `emoji-icon` | Emoji in vis

ible text (symbols such as `©` and `™` are not counted). |
| `heading-subtitle` | Two or more headin

gs each followed by a short subtitle paragraph, or an eyebrow + heading + subtitle triplet. |
| `fil
ler-copy` | Stock marketing filler (一站式, 赋能, 无缝, seamless, elevate your …). |
Known limits: the CSS parsing is regex-based, not a full parser; color keywords such as `white` are
not detected; contrast, tap-target size and rendered font sizes are not measured — use a rendering t
ool for those (for example `design_audit` from dsh-design).

## DSH APIs used

- `ctx.skills.register()` — runtime skill (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`)
- `ctx.on('system-prompt/assemb
le', …)` — appends a runtime context entry after assembly, as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-working-directory` d

oes
- `ctx.workingDirectory.get(session)` — the session's working directory
- `ctx.tools.register(de
fineTool(…))` — tool registration (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`)
The lint only reads files inside the working directory; paths that resolve outside it are rejected.

## Credits
The skill text was written from scratch; ideas were adapted from:
- anthropics/skills · frontend-design (Apache-2.0): plan first, review the plan against generic defa

ults, spend boldness in one place, list of generated-page tells, screenshot self-critique.
- Viger1/
dsh-design design-system skill (license not verified): fix palette and type scale first, one accent,

spacing grid, hit area is not font size.
- SummerSec/SumSec-Skills · taste-skill (Apache-2.0): infe
r direction from the product, avoid the cream + brass "premium" default palette, hue-tinted shadows,

one radius system.
- vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines: `:focus-visible`, no `transition: all`,

`prefers-reduced-motion`, tabular numbers, 44px mobile targets.
- ChenYiming-aaa/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max (
MIT, data from nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill): prioritized checks (contrast, touch, no emoji
ta from nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill): prioritized checks (contrast, touch, no emoji icons).
